game.title: Bear Rush
game.tagline: Watch the water. Snatch the leap. Leave the algae.
game.footer: A quiet stretch of river never lasts.
menu.title: Main menu
controls.title: How to play
controls.desktop: A / D or ← / → adjust river footing · W / S or ↑ / ↓ walk the bank · Space / E catches
controls.touch: Touch: left stick walks · Catch button swipes
controls.goal: Catch leaping salmon by timing your paw swipe. Misses cost nothing.
controls.hazards: Two wood hits cost one life · One algae hit costs one life · Three lives
hint.move: Adjust toward the water or walk along the bank. Watch the salmon in the current.
hint.catch: When a salmon leaps within reach, press Space or E to swipe.
hint.hazards: Two wood hits cost one life. Harmful algae costs one life on contact. You have three lives.
pause.title: Catch your breath
pause.message: The river will wait. Your fishing run is paused.
settings.title: River settings
settings.privacy: Your settings and best run stay in this browser. No account needed.
results.title: The hunt is over
results.message: The river keeps flowing. Ready for another fishing run?
fatal.title: Unable to start
